incident.symptom: LinkedIn and Instagram daily publication can remain silent even while Composio lists connected accounts as ACTIVE.
incident.root_cause: Connection metadata was trusted without a live provider identity call. Revoked LinkedIn OAuth tokens remained ACTIVE in Composio, and multiple Instagram connections with the wrong provider identity could block selection as ambiguous.

prevention: Treat provider ACTIVE metadata as discovery only, never as readiness proof.
Run a live LinkedIn GET_MY_INFO healthcheck before publication claim/capability consumption.
Select one health-verified canonical LinkedIn alias and ignore revoked ACTIVE records.
Read Instagram provider identity and accept only username bedrijfsgeheugen.nl; ignore stale or wrong-identity ACTIVE records.
Keep auth failures at content_ready and consume no social publication capability before health proof.
Resume the same reserved unique artifact after OAuth recovery; never create a replacement merely because auth failed.
evidence: Live Composio LinkedIn healthcheck on 2026-09-26 returned HTTP 401 REVOKED_ACCESS_TOKEN for all three pre-existing LinkedIn connections.
Live Composio Instagram account inspection on 2026-09-26 showed the pre-existing ACTIVE connections resolving to username arthurprinsen rather than the required bedrijfsgeheugen.nl identity.
Buffer account inspection on 2026-09-26 returned HTTP 429 with a long Retry-After, proving Buffer cannot be the availability dependency for LinkedIn/Instagram delivery.
